;Health and environment
*[[2019 Samoa measles outbreak]]
**The [[government of Samoa]] extends the [[state of emergency]] until December 29 when it was due to end on December 15. There have been 72 deaths and more than 5,100 cases to date. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/405509/samoa-measles-state-of-emergency-extended (RNZ)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-measles-samoa/samoa-extends-measles-state-of-emergency-nz-to-fund-pacific-vaccination-campaign-idUSKBN1YI05V (Reuters)]
;Law and crime
*Former [[Sudanese President]] [[Omar al-Bashir]] is sentenced to two years detention in a reform facility for [[corruption in Sudan|corruption]]. There is heavy military custody of the [[Government of Sudan|government]] buildings and the court as followers of his now dissolved party rally in his support. Defense lawyers say they will appeal the sentence. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-sudan-politics-bashir/former-sudan-president-bashir-sentenced-to-two-years-in-detention-for-corruption-idUSKBN1YI087 (Reuters)]
